owned_invariants: The task is the XOR task of xor.rs and optionally max_attempts, an exact integer from 1 to 8; without it the limit is 3. A task the host cannot read is refused before anything is asked.
The first prompt is the task as written. After a rejected attempt the next prompt is the task as written with that attempt's residual under it, and only that attempt's.
The run is certified on the first accepted attempt, as ACCEPTED_FIRST_TRY on attempt 0 and REPAIRED later, and nothing more is asked.
A reply the host cannot read uses up an attempt; its reason is the residual of that attempt.
When the attempts run out or a reply is missing the run is refused as REPAIR_LIMIT_EXHAUSTED.
Every verdict rests on the one predicate accepted_within_limit, whose evidence is the trail: one row per attempt with its measure and residual.
bounded is the loop for any domain: it asks under the stages attempt:0, attempt:1 and so on, and what counts as accepted is the caller's assessment.
boundaries: Acceptance is xor.rs's: even on every cycle and least. A repair that is even and not least is never accepted.
The residual is shown to the model. What it may reveal is the domain's decision, in xor.rs.
The host does not see that successive replies came from one conversation.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed requests, exact unbounded integers and rationals, no float, no unwrap or expect.
